risks: Opaque backends may make quiescence and cleanup difficult to observe; qualification must substantiate those observations on each supported route.
This advances qualification requirements but supplies no measured hardware profile or approved support matrix.
scores.rationale: Mechanical validation confirms clean application, allowed files and preserved question schema. The patch coherently strengthens existing cancellation and isolation gates through generation-bound ownership, aggregate resource accounting, dispatch containment and real-device lifecycle fixtures. It preserves release and retention deadlines, mandatory-slice coverage and operator approval, while accurately keeping UBU-Q0177 Open. Its contribution is a scoped qualification clarification rather than completion of hardware selection.

selection_rationale: The sole candidate is mechanically valid, auditable and directly relevant to secure resource qualification. No blocking fixes are evident; measured hardware selection remains outstanding. This preference is for cross-score aggregation, not final committee selection.
